title: AdminUpdateTakedownRequestCallablePayload
description: One fixed step on a listing request: acknowledge it, ask for more with a fixed template, action it with a fixed outcome (with the takedown case id when the organiser takedown tool ran), decline it with a fixed reason, record its one appeal, decide that appeal, close it, or suspend the organiser page it names (the interim step: publishStatus suppressed and noindex, idempotent, recorded in the history; the takedown tool still runs before the outcome is recorded). Audited.

note.description: An optional staff note for the history; never sent.
